title: Mamba Cement to build grinding plant in Nairobi
summary: Mamba Cement to build grinding plant in Nairobi
body_markdown: **Kenya:** Mamba Cement plans to build a 180t/day grinding and blending plant in Awasi. The US$460,000 unit will market cement in the west of the country, according to the Business Daily newspaper. Rai Cement also operates a cement plant nearby.
